bounded_synthesis.claim: A severe individual event can be distributed across forums whose legitimate scopes emphasize fact finding, process guidance, organizational learning, or population-level enforcement. The resulting architecture can leave individual HR and managerial authorship publicly unresolved even when the institutional sequence is visible.
limits: The ledger does not predict that nobody will ever face accountability.
The ledger does not establish that any forum failed its lawful function.
The ledger does not assign personal blame or legal liability.

channels.explicit_boundary: not a trial and does not assign blame or liability
channels.recovered_function: fact finding concerning who, when, where, and how the death came about

channels.explicit_boundary: no public individual sanction or completed internal accountability ruling recovered
channels.recovered_function: policy revision, advice development, and manager training reported after the event

channels.explicit_boundary: guidance and statutory-code boundaries do not themselves adjudicate this case
channels.recovered_function: notice, reasonable preparation, accompaniment boundaries, and disciplinary good practice

channels.explicit_boundary: HSE generally does not investigate individual stress cases and prioritizes evidence of wider organizational failure affecting several staff
channels.recovered_function: organizational stress-risk duties and wider-failure enforcement triage
